incidents.name: Seneca Protocol
incidents.notes: Chamber contract exposed an external performOperations with arbitrary call, draining user approvals.

sources.ref: onchain review (RPC only): Chamber 0x65c210c59B43EB68112b7a4f75C8393C36491F06 created 2024-02-19T21:18:47Z at block 19264402. Its runtime is a 45-byte EIP-1167 minimal proxy - 0x363d3d373d3d3d363d73 45e15d1e4f92f28a916f4f2971ad9adc278e148b 5af43d82803e903d91602b57fd5bf3 - so the implementation 0x45e15d1e4f92f28a916f4f2971ad9adc278e148b is hard-coded in the bytecode (the single DELEGATECALL at offset 31 targets it) and cannot be repointed: there is no implementation storage slot to move. eth_getLogs for EIP-1967 Upgraded (0xbc7cd75a20ee27fd9adebab32041f755214dbc6bffa90cc0225b39da2e5c2d3b) over [19264402, incident block 19325888] returns 0 logs and eth_getCode is byte-identical at the creation and incident blocks. The implementation was deployed 2024-02-13T00:24:59Z (block 19215501, tx 0xb09975c2cdba88b196b2e67401f79e009aae19617b9ca73ac163d82269bdf794), i.e. older than the clone, so the newest component of the victim's code is the clone deployment. CONFIRMED: deployment basis is exact, codeAgeSeconds 744073 (8.6d) unchanged. Recheck of the deployment basis (DELEGATECALL audit): the victim is an EIP-1167 minimal-proxy clone whose 45-byte runtime hardcodes the master 0x45e15d1e4f92f28a916f4f2971ad9adc278e148b (created at block 19215501 by the same deployer 0x61da869d8eb130cb3d2ba5bbd57c4a53ff534cb4), so the DELEGATECALL target cannot be repointed; the master's runtime is byte-identical at the clone's creation block 19264402 and the incident block 19325889 and contains no DELEGATECALL, so deployment is exact.
exploit tx backfilled and verified onchain (block 19325937; tx to-address is the victim itself), matching the DeFiHackLabs PoC
